impacts.text: This creates a Price Manipulation Attack Vector enabling Forced Capital Inefficiency:
the newly minted position is centered around the manipulated price and becomes entirely out-of-range at the true market price
complete loss of fee-earning opportunity while the position remains out-of-range
gas costs required to rebalance the position back into productive range
potential impermanent loss realization when closing or rebalancing the position depending on price movement between position creation and correction
opportunity cost from capital being locked in non-productive positions rather than earning yield
Multiple sequential operations on different vulnerable pools compound the economic damage.

guaranteed capital inefficiency, assured opportunity cost from zero fee earnings, required operational overhead to detect and correct mispositioned liquidity, and cumulative economic impact when multiple positions are affected or positions remain uncorrected

ambiguities: Omitted outcome: exposure of initial capital deployment to this attack in cross-chain deployments targeting fresh Uniswap V3 pools (e_36bbc61e78c5_0013).
